:::{#exm-palindromes-linear-time}
#### Palindromes in linear time

Let PAL be the [decision problem](p-and-np.qmd#def-decision-problem)
whose yes inputs are the palindromes.
The machine of @exm-palindrome-machine
[computes](#def-tm-computes) the function that is $1$ on palindromes and $0$ on other strings,
so it [decides](#def-tm-computes) PAL.
On an input of length $n$,
the copy phase takes $n + 1$ steps,
the rewind phase exactly $n + 2$,
and the compare phase at most $n + 1$.
So the machine [runs in time](p-and-np.qmd#def-running-time) $3n + 4$,
which is $\asymub{n}$,
and PAL is in [P](p-and-np.qmd#def-class-p).
Palindromes take all $3n + 4$ steps,
and other inputs stop sooner, at their first mismatch.

:::
